reviews.title: Problems with the spanish language
reviews.text: The app is good, but the horoscope in Spanish is not working, please fix it🙏🏻
reviews.reply:
We are sincerely sorry about this inconvenience. We updated our application, so it gives a more specific horoscope depending on the location where you were born. So please try to reinstall the app and when entering your place of birth, make sure that you choose a location from the list when it appears. If the app does not suggest the location you entered in the list, please try to simplify the location to find it in the list. 

If you have started our paid subscription, you'll be able to re-activate it - just tap “Restore” on a subscription screen you get. 

Please let us know if this does not help. Again, our team apologizes for this inconvenience. We are just trying to make our users' experience better.

reviews.title: nebula
reviews.text: it dosent let me place my birth month, it say it’s unavailable
reviews.reply:
Dear User, hello there!
Unfortunately, we need to follow the legal requirements of your country.We have the following age restrictions for different countries:
16 years for the EU,
13 years for USA / Canada,
15 years for Australia,
for all other countries -13 years,

In the future, we plan to add a new feature - Family Member: Adult users will register an account, and then will be able to add a user less than the limited age.
